- (a19) (alpha regression) Fixed the Pet respawn countdown never counting down, leaving Pets permanently dead — most often after a server reload, or for a player's very first Pet
- (a19) Fixed Pet death messages showing an internal text key (such as "name.custom") instead of the name of whatever killed the Pet
- (a19) Starvation damage from the hunger system is now reported as its own named damage source instead of an unnamed generic one
- (a19) (v4 regression) Fixed Pet Rename menu dropping the name tag upon rename
- (a19) (alpha regression) Fixed custom-model Pets (MythicMobs, ModelEngine, BetterModel, ItemsAdder) briefly appearing and then vanishing with an error when called
- (a19) (v4 regression) Fixed Bat Pets not respecting its "stay" command
- (a18) (alpha regression) Fixed English translation keys missing from pet volume GUI
- (a18) (alpha regression) Fixed the `levels` keyword not showing up in tab-completion for `/petadmin exp <player> <amount>`
- (a18) (alpha regression) Fixed Pets moving abnormally fast after being released back into the wild
- (a18) (alpha regression) Fixed inventory dupe when owner dies and DropWhenOwnerDies is set to true
- (a17) Implemented per-command admin permissions
- (a17) Added support for custom Pet types through BetterModel (recommended), ModelEngine, ItemsAdder, and MythicMobs
- (a17) Added support for custom model overlays for Pets through BetterModel (recommended), ModelEngine, and ItemsAdder
- (a17) Fixed tamed or purchased Pets showing an internal text key (such as "name.zombie") instead of their proper name
- (a17) Hardened the web editor: payloads are now authenticated end-to-end, file writes are sandboxed against path traversal, the WebEditor.Enabled toggle is enforced, relay and socket payload sizes are capped, and browser-trust confirmation is bound to the session owner
- (a17) (alpha regression) Fix WorldGuard hook
- (a16) (alpha regression) Fixed the Pickup skill removing items from the ground without depositing them into the Pet's backpack when the backpack is open
- (a15) Added support for Paper 26.2
- (a15) Added support for upcoming MyPet web editor
- (a15) (alpha regression) Fixed the Pickup skill removing items from the ground without depositing them into the Pet's backpack
- (a15) (v4 regression) Restored pet sound volume control - intercepts sound packets via PacketEvents (preferred) or ProtocolLib (fallback)
- (a15) Added a volume slider GUI - opens from `/petsettings volume` (no arg) or the volume button in `/pet`, with five presets at 0/25/50/75/100%
- (a15) Added `Volume-Control` and `Volume-Mode` (per-owner or per-player) flags to `hooks-config.yml` under each packet adapter's section
- (a15) Fixed Zone-Messages config option for the Beacon skill
- (a15) Renamed `/petsettings idle-volume` to `/petsettings volume` and broadened scope from ambient-only sounds to every sound a Pet emits
- (a15) Removed Javascript experience calculator in favor of new experience modes (linear, power, exponential)
- (a15) (api) Removed the global Configuration class; plugin-wide config values are now ConfigKey<?> static fields on MyPetGlobal (read via MyPetGlobal.Section.KEY.get())
- (a15) (api) Level rules are now a sealed LevelRule interface with nested Dynamic/Static records (replaces the DynamicLevelRule/StaticLevelRule classes)
- (a14) Added `/pet` — a single-screen pet management menu with 17 buttons (rename, call, info, stay, auto-respawn, send-away, store, switch, trade, release, choose-skilltree, skilltree-info, backpack, behavior, pickup, stop-attacking, volume)
- (a14) Implemented new GUI system and replaced all existing GUIs
- (a14) Added CanDropScute config flag to Turtle Pets
- (a14) Added PreventNaturalGrowup config option for baby Pets (default true)
- (a14) Added PreventProfessionChange config option for Villager Pets (default true)
- (a14) Added support for the golden dandelion to freeze a Pet's aging (Minecraft 26.1+)
- (a14) Updated all hook dependencies to latest versions
- (a14) Replaced Kingdoms hook with KingdomsX hook
- (a14) Removed FabledSkyblock hook
- (a14) Removed GangsPlus hook
- (a14) Removed NoCheatPlus hook
- (a14) Harden Mojang locale download system
- (a14) Fixed Pets not teleporting to owner if owner is standing on carpet, snow, etc
- (a14) (alpha regression) Fixed Wither Pets showing as available as a baby
- (a14) (alpha regression) Fixed being unable to ride pets when ride item is set to air
- (a14) (alpha regression) Fixed leash flags not being respected
- (a14) (v4 regression) Fixed Pet owners being able to duplicate bucketable pets
- (a14) (v4 regression) Fixed startup Copper Golem migration error on 1.20.6-1.21.8
- (a14) (v4 regression) Fix Pets losing certain options (profession, collar colors, etc) upon release
- (a14) (v4 regression) Fixed Polar Bear Pets not playing their attack animation when hitting a target
- (a14) (v4 regression) Fixed Villager Pets pathfinding to beds, work locations, and villagers
- (a13) Added AllowLeafDestruction config option for Ravager Pets (default false)
- (a13) Added PreventSuffocation config option for Nautilus Pets (default true)
- (a13) Contributor list refresh interval reduced from every 10 minutes to every 12 hours
- (a13) (v4 regression) Fixed Warden Pets autonomously targeting and attacking their owner
- (a13) (v4 regression) Fixed Warden Pets applying a darkness effect to nearby players
- (a13) (v4 regression) Fixed Warden Pets retaliating against their owner when attacked
- (a13) (v4 regression) Fixed Ravager Pets not playing their forward-lunge attack animation when hitting a target
- (a13) (v4 regression) Fixed `screaming` creation option for Enderman Pets not making the pet stay in its angry/screaming state
- (a13) (v4 regression) Fixed Enderman Pets staying in the angry/screaming visual state after combat
- (a13) (v4 regression) Fixed Copper Golem Pets reaching an oxidized state and becoming immobile
- (a13) (v4 regression) Fixed Camel and Camel Husk Pets autonomously sitting down
- (a13) (v4 regression) Fixed Camel Pets wandering off on their own
- (a13) (v4 regression) Fixed Copper Golem Pets autonomously pulling items out of copper chests and depositing them in regular chests
- (a13) (v4 regression) Fixed /pbeacon throwing IllegalArgumentException on Paper 1.21.9+
- (a13) (api) Added PetBrainBehaviorRemoval for per-pet declarations of vanilla NMS brain behaviors to strip at spawn
- (a12) Added RequireRideSkill config option for naturally rideable Pets (default true)
- (a12) Added RequireRideItem config option for naturally rideable Pets (default true)
- (a12) Added AllowNonOwnerPrimaryMount config option for naturally rideable Pets (default false)
- (a12) Added AllowNonOwnerSecondaryMount config option for naturally multi-passenger Pets - Camel, Camel Husk, and Happy Ghast (default true)
- (a12) Added RequireSaddle config option for saddleable Pets (default false)
- (a12) Added AllowNonOwnerSaddle config option for saddleable Pets (default false)
- (a12) Added harness:<color> creation option for Happy Ghast Pets
- (a12) Added /petride command - mounts your active Pet (requires the Ride skill unless RequireRideSkill is false)
- (a12) Added /petride driver|passengers allow|disallow subcommand - lets Pet owners opt in to other players riding
- (a12) Added OverrideFlySpeed (default false) and FlySpeed config options per Pet type
- (a12) Improve reliability of Pet migration from v3 to v4
- (a12) Set Bee, Parrot, and Wither fly speed defaults to tuned values, as the vanilla values are way too fast
- (a12) (v4 regression) Fixed non-owners able to ride any rideable Pet without the Ride skill, the MyPet.extended.ride permission, or being the Pet's owner
- (a12) (v4 regression) Fixed flying Pets feeling slow when ridden with the Ride skill - base flight speed is now either a per-pet override or derived from the live FLYING_SPEED Bukkit attribute (falling back to MOVEMENT_SPEED)
- (a12) (v4 regression) Fixed Pets entering a die-respawn-die loop after being killed by fall damage or powder-snow freeze damage
- (a12) (v4 regression) Fixed flying Pets not performing melee attacks or responding to the Control skill
- (a12) (v4 regression) Fixed Breeze Pets autonomously firing wind charges at their owner and any other nearby entities
- (a12) (alpha regression) Fixed ridden Pets able to gain altitude without the Ride skill's CanFly upgrade
- (a12) (alpha regression) Fixed ridden Pets taking fall damage from rider-controlled descending flight as if they had free-fallen from the peak altitude
- (a12) (api) Added PetNaturallyRideable and PetMultiPassenger marker interfaces
- (a12) (api) Widened PetSaddleable marker to cover Pig, Strider, Nautilus, Zombie Nautilus, Happy Ghast, and Camel Husk Pets
- (a12) (api) Added `PetInfo#isOverrideFlySpeed/setOverrideFlySpeed` and `PetInfo#getFlySpeed/setFlySpeed` methods, `@DefaultInfo#overrideFlySpeed` (boolean) and `@DefaultInfo#flySpeed` (double) annotation fields, and `RideSkillFlightController#resolveBaseSpeed` shared helper
- (a11) Per-pet creation options now take string names - `variant:lucy` for Axolotl, `profession:armorer` for Villager, `collar:red` for Cat/Wolf, etc.
- (a11) Horse Pet `variant:` option split into `color:` and `style:`
- (a11) Tropical Fish Pet `variant:` option split into `pattern:`, `body-color:`, and `pattern-color:`
- (a11) Cat Pet variant option renamed from `type:` to `variant:`
- (a11) `/petadmin create` now aborts with a clear error when an option value isn't recognized for the chosen pet type
- (a11) Snow Golem Pet `sheared` option renamed to `derp`
- (a11) Removed `noshake` creation option for Hoglin / Piglin / Piglin Brute Pets. Zombification immunity is controlled by the `AllowZombification` config option
- (a11) Added `pet-shops.yml` migration that converts pre-v4 int-form `Options:` entries to the string form v4 requires (e.g. `variant:2` → `variant:gold`)
- (a11) Fixed `tamed` creation option not tab-completing for some Pet types
- (a11) Fixed Angry leash flag only working for Wolves
- (a11) (v4 regression) Fixed `CanOxidize` config option for Copper Golem Pets not being respected
- (a11) (v4 regression) Fixed `CanRegrowWool` config option for Sheep Pets not being respected
- (a11) (api) Added `WildAngerCheck<T extends Mob>` for per-pet capture-time anger predicates
- (a11) (api) Removed `Configuration.MyPet.Pets.*`, per-pet config flags are now `ConfigKey<?>` static fields on each `PetXxx` class
- (a11) (api) Added `PetBehavior<E>` for per-pet event handlers - declared as static fields on each `PetXxx` class via `PetBehaviorHelpers.onPetInteract`/`onPetExplodes`/`onPetDamaged`/etc., dispatched centrally by `PetBehaviorDispatcher`.
- (a11) (api) Added `PetLifecycleHook` for per-pet runtime hooks (scheduler tasks, scoreboard teams, vanilla-state overrides on spawn/despawn)
- (a10) Added variant creation option for Salmon Pets

- (a10) Added AllowLightningPower to Creeper Pet (default false)

- (a10) (v4 regression) Fixed hostile mobs retaliating against the Pet's owner instead of the Pet when the Pet hits them

- (a10) (v4 regression) Fix CanTossUp config option for Iron Golem Pets not working
- (a10) Removed CanGlide config value (vanilla slow-fall isn't controllable via Spigot/Paper, so the toggle had no enforceable behavior)
- (a10) (api) Registration methods (registerSkill/Requirement/LeashFlag/Hook) now throw IllegalArgumentException on missing annotations, duplicates, or invalid types instead of failing silently
- (a10) (api) Narrow PetInteractEvent#getPet() and PetStatusEvent#getPet() return type from StoredPet to Pet
- (a10) (api) Replace Settings#map()/Setting#getValue() with typed accessors (getInt/getDouble/getString/getBoolean returning Optional*, plus entries())
- (a10) (api) Added SkillStateCodec to replace the NBTStorage + SkillStateParser pair for stateful skills
